experiment: Stage 7.2 factor check: Drive, Register, and 28-way interaction at focus-token layer 6
reserved_interpretation: This is a readout-level factorization test for the Stage 7 Foundation signal. It asks whether Drive, Register, and the full 28-way interaction are each readable from focus-token layer-6 activations beyond text baselines and whether their trained readout subspaces are necessary for those readouts. It does not test generated-language control.

notes.metadata_is_diagnostic_not_gate: For Drive/Register, pair+focus metadata can identify the factor by construction because the fixture explicitly contrasts factor pairs. The claim-bearing gate is activation-vs-text plus readout-subspace ablation.
